criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Terfila
criterion.wasted_life: letting Terfila slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: works the morning tide unloading crates at the stalls, swapping gossip for cheap drink, and picking up the knack of telling the tollhouse story differently to whoever's listening.

arc.premise: Tamuzarlo wants a proper watch rotation set up for the market stalls along the transit route after two seasons of goods going missing at the changeover - he has people willing, just no one willing to organize it first.
